label: Hoodoo Run
note: Issue #610: the first race course, a loop through the desert round five rock towers, its start/finish line a short drive from Dorrin's yard (the mechanic_yard landmark in content/core/worlds/port_desert.json). Read by src/systems/racing/race_course.gd (RaceCourse). Everything is plateau x,z (the world's landmark coordinates; on the ball they are mapped onto the sphere like any landmark). `gates`: gate 0 is the start/finish line, the rest the checkpoints in the order you go through them. The course is a straight leg from each gate to the next, round the loop, and nothing else: there is no racing line in the file. RaceCourse.load_course builds it from the gates (straight along the ground), NPC racers drive straight at the gates (issue #609), each gate faces the way the legs run through it, and the boulders keep off the legs; so to change the track, move or add a gate. Lay the legs down the valleys between the dunes and cross a ridge only at its lowest saddle, square on. This one: from the start at the head of the long valley south of the yard, down the valley (c1) and round the basin at its foot (c2), over the basin's south rim into the south-west trough (c3, c4), into the hollow at the foot of the hook valley (c5), up the hook valley (c6), through the hollow by the first tower (c7) and over the saddle back into the start valley (c8). `gate_width` is the gap between its two antennas (m). `grid`: the slots behind the start line (rows of two, `back_m` behind it, `row_m` between rows, `side_m` either side of the middle). `laps`: a race's laps. `draw_m`: gates and markers are built when you come this close to the course's middle and dropped past draw_m + 200. `clear_m`: the desert's boulders keep this far off the legs and the gates (DesertLandforms clear circles). Gates go on flat ground (tests/test_race_course.gut.gd checks the sand under every gate, and under the start line's grid, is nearly level before any levelling), and the planet then levels a pad under each (RaceCourse.flat_sites, PlanetSphere flat sites like an outpost's) so both antennas stand at one height and the beam runs flat. Optional `pad`: { margin_m round the antennas (3), blend_m out to the open sand (18) }. The rock towers it weaves round are hoodoos in content/look/desert_landforms.json, each beside a leg. Issue #612: `beast` is the track beast, a second beetle-centipede that is on the course only while a race runs: the planet's beast's numbers (content/core/hazards/beast.json and the planet's block) with this block over them; home defaults to the middle of the course, leash_m keeps it crossing the legs now and then; killed, it stays dead under its own flag (beast_slain_<planet>_track, or `key`).
